source: Jan's print, sliced by hand: _input/Christmas_tree_plate_2.gcode.3mf (Bambu Studio 02.09.01.70, X1C + AMS, painted in the slicer; the file holds only G-code). Read with tools/slice_paint_check.py --gcode
